The historical wording and mechanical images are excluded from Triptych’s CC BY 4.0 grant. No modern translation, critical reconstruction, or newly composed prayer is supplied. text: COmmunicántes, & diem sacratíssimum celebrántes, quo Dóminus noster, vnigénitus Fílius tuus, vnítam sibi fragilitátis nostræ substántiam, in glóriæ tuæ déxtera collocáuit. Sed & memóriam venerántes, in primis gloriósæ semper vírginis Maríæ, genitrícis eiúsdem Dei & Dómini nostri Iesu Christi: sed & beatórum Apostolórum ac Mártyrum tuórum, &c.
